props.text: One recording becomes a month of content.

You speak into your phone once. No studio, no script and no editing on your end. My team and I take that one recording and cut it into short videos, written pieces and captions. Each one is sized for the place it will be shown. We line them up in one place for you to approve with one tap, and then they go out all month on the accounts you choose. You are not getting a list of ideas to go write yourself. You are getting finished pieces, with your face and your voice on them. And every one of them tells people where to go next, which is your website.

text.label: Text: Free before paid
text.value: Free before paid

text.label: Heading: Why free attention comes before paid attention.
text.value: Why free attention comes before paid attention.

text.label: Text: What it costs now.
text.value: What it costs now.

text.label: Text: For most of my forty years in business, attention was someth
text.value: For most of my forty years in business, attention was something you bought. That is not where you are standing. The platforms your followers are on every day charge you nothing to be in front of them, and your own podcast costs next to nothing once my team sets it up. So the price has moved. It is no longer money. It is being there every week, with something worth watching, long after the novelty wears off. Most people cannot keep that up alone, and that is the only reason free attention goes to waste. Keeping it up is the part this system takes off you.

text.label: Text: Self-promotion, done for you.
text.value: Self-promotion, done for you.

text.label: Text: My team and I are a modern day talent agency. Being seen is
text.value: My team and I are a modern day talent agency. Being seen is free now. Knowing how to get seen, week after week, and get paid for it, is still a skill. Whatever you do for a living, you have to do self-promotion to make it work, and most people were never shown how. This system is the self-promotion, done for you. You talk about what you know. We make sure the right people see it, over and over, and we send them to the place where they can pay you.

text.label: Text: You did the hard part.
text.value: You did the hard part.

text.label: Text: You already have followers. Those people chose to watch you.
text.value: You already have followers. Those people chose to watch you. Nobody paid to push you in front of them. That is the most valuable attention there is, because it comes with some trust already built in. A person who followed you on purpose is partway to buying before you say a word. Paying to reach strangers while the people who already like you only hear from you now and then is doing it backwards. So we start with the crowd you have already earned.

text.label: Text: Free shows what works.
text.value: Free shows what works.

text.label: Text: Every video you put out is a small test that costs you nothi
text.value: Every video you put out is a small test that costs you nothing. Some of your stories make people stop, watch and come over to your website. Others get a polite nod and a scroll. Over time we learn which of your lessons make people move, and we make more of those. When advertising gets added later, as the sixth system, we are not guessing what to put money behind. By the time a dollar goes behind a message, your own audience has already told us it works.

text.label: Text: It keeps working.
text.value: It keeps working.

text.label: Text: An ad stops the day you stop paying for it. A video does not
text.value: An ad stops the day you stop paying for it. A video does not. A clip you put out this month can still be found long after, by somebody typing what you teach into Google. A podcast episode sits on your website for as long as you want it there. Every piece adds to a library with your name on it, and that library points at a website you own. That is the difference between renting attention for a week and building a library that keeps sending people to you.

text.value: Being seen is free now. Knowing how to get seen, week after week, and get paid for it, is still a skill.

It is the cutting, the captions, the titles and the remembering that wear a person down, and that is where good intentions go quiet. That part is now somebody else's job. AI employees do the heavy lifting day and night, my team checks the work before it reaches you, and I am on your account personally. Yours is the recording and a yes.

props.text: Why this one is number two.

Content is what sends people to you, and it is free. The website is what catches them when they arrive, which is why it comes first. Send a crowd at a page that cannot catch them and you have shown more people the weak spot. Think of a restaurant. You do not hand out flyers until the kitchen can feed the people who walk in. So we build the website first, with your e-book and your podcast on it. Then we turn on the content. And the systems after it answer, follow up and book, so the people your videos send over are met by something when they get there. That is also why you cannot buy this one by itself. All six go in, in the same order every time, as one build.
